description: Look up NerdyData report IDs (UUIDs) by technology name, category, or code snippet. ALWAYS call this before search_code when the user mentions a technology by name (e.g. 'Shopify', 'Braze', 'WordPress'). For questions like 'how many websites use X and Y together?', call this once per technology, then pass all UUIDs to search_code using the 'all' field. Returns UUIDs that you then pass to search_code, search_titles, search_descriptions, or create_download.

search.description: Technology name, category, or code snippet to look up (e.g. 'Shopify', 'Marketing Automation', 'intercom')

name: get_suggestions
